plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure, aligning with capital preservation.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the single name mandate.
Reduce CRWD to 10% to further diversify and manage single name risk.
Buy ADI at 5% to add a high-scoring, quality long setup to the portfolio.
This plan aims for a large cash buffer and tight stops for stability.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, prioritizing capital preservation and low drawdown. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and diversifying holdings. Expect lower volatility but also more modest growth potential.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure while maintaining a small allocation.
Reduce SPY to 25% to address concentration and meet the single name mandate.
Buy ADI at 4% to introduce a high-scoring, quality long setup.
This strategy balances growth with risk management, maintaining a moderate cash buffer.
balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for approximately 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while blending broad index exposure with quality tech. Expect moderate volatility and growth potential.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet the single name mandate while maintaining significant broad index exposure.
Add to SOXL and SPAL, targeting 6% each, to increase leveraged ETF exposure for aggressive growth.
Buy ADI at 6% and ZS at 4% to concentrate in high-scoring scanner setups.
This plan uses leverage and concentration to stretch growth, with strict stops.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It leans into leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups, which significantly raises both upside and drawdown potential. Be aware that leveraged ETFs decay daily, and this approach can lead to substantial losses quickly if stops are not strictly adhered to.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure, prioritizing low drawdown.
Sell CRWD to remove high-beta single name exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the single name mandate.
Add to QQQI, targeting 30%, to significantly increase exposure to income-generating ETFs.
This plan focuses on steady monthly distributions and capital preservation.
income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, prioritizing steady monthly distributions and low drawdown. It rotates into income/covered-call ETFs and broad index funds, cutting leverage and high-beta names. While aiming for reliable income, distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
